published.source: PR #54 (client 70425: Judgement of Righteousness 42.9%, Champion of the Light 10 / 20 / 30%, Consecration 4.2% a tick; Seal of Righteousness spell power once per the tooltip; Concentration Aura; Human, 2026-10-16)

summary: The Holy Shock build for an Undead or Demon boss. It adds Exorcism and saves more mana for Light's Vigil in longer fights.
advantage: Exorcism and Holy Wrath only work on Undead and Demons, so here they add damage on top of the usual rotation. This build adds Exorcism to its Holy Shock rotation.
advantageShort: Exorcism and Holy Wrath only hit Undead and Demons, so they add damage here. Exorcism joins the Holy Shock rotation.
rotation: Pre-pull: Seal of Righteousness at -3s, Light's Vigil at -1.5s
Consecration on cooldown, down to the last point of mana
Judgement on cooldown on Seal of Righteousness; re-seal Righteousness whenever it is down (no twisting)
Light's Vigil whenever it is not on the target and mana is at or above 30%
Holy Shock on a Vigil-marked target (detonates it, refunds 75% of its mana, starts no cooldown), or on cooldown below 30% mana; Divine Favor goes on a Holy Shock
Racials, Goblin Sapper, Major Mana Potion and Demonic Rune on free GCDs
consumes: Elixir of Greater Firepower (Forever's Holy Power elixir)
caveats: Exorcism only hits Undead and Demons, so this build is only for those bosses.
Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets: 32 spell power and 18 crit rating, and an on-use 140 spell power for 20s every 2 min (at the pull, then on cooldown).
Divine Precision's hit doesn't cover Judgement of Righteousness.
Holy Shock is worth 148 DPS and Light's Vigil about 91 (measured before client 70425).
A missed Holy Shock uses up the Vigil with no detonation or refund. This is small at about 1% Holy miss.
Human is best since client 70425 (Ruthless, 2% crit with any weapon), about 2 to 3 ahead of Undead (Touch of the Grave) at 180s.
Holy Strike's flat bonus is inside the 50% weapon percent per client data. Not yet confirmed on the beta.
High Holy Strike and Consecration ranks may be out of date. Holding them to their level 30 trend would cost about 1.2%.

Seal of Righteousness adds 12% of spell power a hit with a two-hander, once, per the 70425 tooltip (the proc spell itself has 0). The SoD-style double count (2 x 11%) would be about 46-51 DPS higher. The proc spell's 0 would be about 53-59 lower.
notes: Request from mksettings with the same arguments as paladin__level_60_shock except talents and APL, then the target's mobType set to MobTypeUndead, as the class preset's encounter does.
